evals.name: cart-concurrency-bug
evals.prompt: The cart total is sometimes wrong when two users add items at the same time. Find and fix the root cause. Add a regression test.
evals.expected_output: Identifies shared module-level mutable state, explains the concurrent-request scenario, scopes state per request/session, and adds a regression test.
assertions: Identifies the shared mutable module-level total as the root cause
Explains the concurrent-request scenario that produces the wrong total
Fixes by scoping state per request or session, not by hiding the symptom
Adds a regression test that exercises concurrency
Does not merely add a try/catch, sleep, or restart
